summary: Seven-band pixel equalizer with spring-loaded bands, a smooth curve and a live spectrum behind; presets cascade band by band.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when a drag ends, on each ArrowUp or ArrowDown press, on a double-click reset and when a preset is chosen. `gains` holds seven target values in dB; `preset` is present only for presets.

methods.description: Applies a preset with a left-to-right cascade and fires `change`. An unknown name is ignored.

keyboard.action: Select the previous or next band.
Raise or lower the selected band by 1 dB.

accessibility: The canvas is focusable with `role="group"` and `aria-label="Equalizer. Left and right pick a band, up and down change its gain."`.
Individual bands have no ARIA values. A visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` line reports the selected band and its gain after each arrow key, for example "1k Hz, +4.0 dB".
Preset buttons are native toggle buttons; `aria-pressed` marks the preset in effect and clears when a band is changed by hand.
motion: With reduced motion, bands jump to their new gain instead of springing and the spectrum stops flickering, so the canvas only redraws on input; presets still apply band by band.
notes: Bands are 60, 150, 400, 1k, 2.4k, 6k and 15k, each from -12 to +12 dB. Dragging snaps to 0.5 dB; double-clicking a band sets it to 0.
The spectrum is simulated and no audio is processed. The canvas is 196px tall.

data.note: The spectrum behind the bands is simulated; only the bands are a real control.
